quests.conceptTitle: Speech Bubble to Report Converter: Reported Yes/No Question
quests.directSpeech: Sofia asked, "Do you like Italian food?"
quests.reportedSpeech: Sofia asked whether I liked Italian food.
changesList: question word order → statement word order
quests.ruleExplanation: The auxiliary 'do' disappears, 'like' backshifts to 'liked', and 'whether' introduces the reported question.
quests.nativeTip: Reported yes/no questions use 'if' or 'whether' instead of 'that', and drop the question word order.
quests.backshiftSummary: 🔄 Quote ➔ Report: "Sofia asked, "Do you like Italian food?"" ➔ "Sofia asked whether I liked Italian food."

quests.conceptTitle: Speech Bubble to Report Converter: Reported Yes/No Question
quests.directSpeech: The waiter asked, "Would you like some water?"
quests.reportedSpeech: The waiter asked whether I would like some water.
changesList: question word order → statement word order
quests.ruleExplanation: 'Would' does not need to backshift further, but the inverted question order becomes normal statement order, and 'you' becomes 'I'.
quests.nativeTip: Keep the modal 'would' as it is, but change the word order to a statement.
quests.backshiftSummary: 🔄 Quote ➔ Report: "The waiter asked, "Would you like some water?"" ➔ "The waiter asked whether I would like some water."

quests.conceptTitle: Speech Bubble to Report Converter: Reported Yes/No Question
quests.directSpeech: Marcus asked, "Are you coming to the party?"
quests.reportedSpeech: Marcus asked whether I was coming to the party.
changesList: question word order → statement word order
quests.ruleExplanation: 'Are' backshifts to 'was', the inversion disappears, and 'you' becomes 'I'.
quests.nativeTip: 'Are' is part of the question — think about its past form and remove the inversion.
quests.backshiftSummary: 🔄 Quote ➔ Report: "Marcus asked, "Are you coming to the party?"" ➔ "Marcus asked whether I was coming to the party."

quests.conceptTitle: Speech Bubble to Report Converter: Reported Yes/No Question
quests.directSpeech: The doctor asked, "Are you feeling better?"
quests.reportedSpeech: The doctor asked if I was feeling better.
changesList: question word order → statement word order
quests.ruleExplanation: 'Are feeling' backshifts to 'was feeling', and the question order becomes a statement; 'you' becomes 'I'.
quests.nativeTip: Backshift the continuous tense and remove the inverted word order.
quests.backshiftSummary: 🔄 Quote ➔ Report: "The doctor asked, "Are you feeling better?"" ➔ "The doctor asked if I was feeling better."

quests.conceptTitle: Speech Bubble to Report Converter: Reported Yes/No Question
quests.directSpeech: Elena asked, "Is he working today?"

quests.ruleExplanation: 'Is working' becomes 'was working', 'today' becomes 'that day', and normal word order replaces the inversion.
quests.nativeTip: Check the continuous tense, the time word, and the sentence order all at once.
quests.backshiftSummary: 🔄 Quote ➔ Report: "Elena asked, "Is he working today?"" ➔ "Elena asked if he was working that day."

quests.conceptTitle: Speech Bubble to Report Converter: Reported Yes/No Question
quests.directSpeech: The customer asked, "Are these seats available?"
quests.reportedSpeech: The customer asked if those seats were available.

quests.ruleExplanation: 'Are' becomes 'were', 'these' becomes 'those', and question order becomes statement order.

quests.backshiftSummary: 🔄 Quote ➔ Report: "The customer asked, "Are these seats available?"" ➔ "The customer asked if those seats were available."

quests.backshiftSummary: 🔄 Quote ➔ Report: "The teacher asked, "Does she understand the lesson?"" ➔ "The teacher asked if she understood the lesson."

quests.backshiftSummary: 🔄 Quote ➔ Report: "Hassan asked, "Do they live nearby?"" ➔ "Hassan asked whether they lived nearby."

quests.conceptTitle: Speech Bubble to Report Converter: Mixed Reported Speech

quests.reportedSpeech: The nurse asked whether my symptoms had improved.
changesList: question word order → statement word order

quests.nativeTip: Along with the tense, notice the possessive pronoun change.
quests.backshiftSummary: 🔄 Quote ➔ Report: "The nurse asked, "Have your symptoms improved?"" ➔ "The nurse asked whether my symptoms had improved."

quests.conceptTitle: Speech Bubble to Report Converter: Reported Yes/No Question
quests.directSpeech: The clerk asked, "Can you show your ID?"
quests.reportedSpeech: The clerk asked whether I could show my ID.
changesList: question word order → statement word order
quests.ruleExplanation: 'Can' becomes 'could', 'you'/'your' become 'I'/'my', and the order becomes a statement.
quests.nativeTip: 'Can' backshifts to its past form even inside a question.
quests.backshiftSummary: 🔄 Quote ➔ Report: "The clerk asked, "Can you show your ID?"" ➔ "The clerk asked whether I could show my ID."

quests.conceptTitle: Speech Bubble to Report Converter: Mixed Reported Speech
quests.directSpeech: Omar asked, "Will you join us for dinner?"
quests.reportedSpeech: Omar asked whether I would join them for dinner.
changesList: question word order → statement word order
quests.ruleExplanation: 'Will' becomes 'would', 'you' becomes 'I', and 'us' becomes 'them' since the reporter isn't part of that group.
quests.nativeTip: Both the modal and the object pronoun 'us' change here.
quests.backshiftSummary: 🔄 Quote ➔ Report: "Omar asked, "Will you join us for dinner?"" ➔ "Omar asked whether I would join them for dinner."

quests.conceptTitle: Speech Bubble to Report Converter: Reported Yes/No Question

quests.reportedSpeech: The teacher asked whether anyone could answer that question.

quests.ruleExplanation: 'Can' becomes 'could', 'this' becomes 'that', and normal word order replaces the question form.
quests.nativeTip: Check the modal, the demonstrative, and the word order together.
quests.backshiftSummary: 🔄 Quote ➔ Report: "The teacher asked, "Can anyone answer this question?"" ➔ "The teacher asked whether anyone could answer that question."

quests.conceptTitle: Speech Bubble to Report Converter: Reported Yes/No Question
quests.directSpeech: Layla asked, "Is it raining outside?"
quests.reportedSpeech: Layla asked whether it was raining outside.
changesList: question word order → statement word order
quests.ruleExplanation: 'Is' becomes 'was', and the inverted order 'is it' becomes the statement order 'it was'.
quests.nativeTip: Move the verb 'to be' back into normal statement position and backshift it.
quests.backshiftSummary: 🔄 Quote ➔ Report: "Layla asked, "Is it raining outside?"" ➔ "Layla asked whether it was raining outside."

quests.conceptTitle: Speech Bubble to Report Converter: Mixed Reported Speech
quests.directSpeech: The host asked, "Are your parents joining us tonight?"
quests.reportedSpeech: The host asked whether my parents were joining them that night.
quests.ruleExplanation: 'Your' becomes 'my', 'are joining' becomes 'were joining', 'us' becomes 'them', and 'tonight' becomes 'that night'.
quests.nativeTip: Four things shift together: the possessive, the verb, the object pronoun, and the time word.
quests.backshiftSummary: 🔄 Quote ➔ Report: "The host asked, "Are your parents joining us tonight?"" ➔ "The host asked whether my parents were joining them that night."

quests.conceptTitle: Speech Bubble to Report Converter: Reported Yes/No Question

quests.reportedSpeech: The inspector asked whether the exits were clearly marked.
changesList: question word order → statement word order

quests.nativeTip: No pronoun here — just backshift the verb and remove the inversion.
quests.backshiftSummary: 🔄 Quote ➔ Report: "The inspector asked, "Are the exits clearly marked?"" ➔ "The inspector asked whether the exits were clearly marked."

quests.conceptTitle: Speech Bubble to Report Converter: Reported Yes/No Question
quests.directSpeech: Fatima asked, "Don't you want any dessert?"
quests.reportedSpeech: Fatima asked whether I didn't want any dessert.
changesList: question word order → statement word order
quests.ruleExplanation: 'Don't want' backshifts to 'didn't want', and inverted order becomes statement order; 'you' becomes 'I'.
quests.nativeTip: Negative questions keep their negative form — only the auxiliary tense and word order change.
quests.backshiftSummary: 🔄 Quote ➔ Report: "Fatima asked, "Don't you want any dessert?"" ➔ "Fatima asked whether I didn't want any dessert."

quests.conceptTitle: Speech Bubble to Report Converter: Reported Yes/No Question
quests.directSpeech: The critic asked, "Isn't this film too long?"

quests.backshiftSummary: 🔄 Quote ➔ Report: "The critic asked, "Isn't this film too long?"" ➔ "The critic asked whether that film wasn't too long."

quests.conceptTitle: Speech Bubble to Report Converter: Reported Yes/No Question

quests.nativeTip: This negative past question backshifts one more step, just like ordinary past-simple statements do.
quests.backshiftSummary: 🔄 Quote ➔ Report: "The teacher asked, "Didn't you study for the test?"" ➔ "The teacher asked whether I hadn't studied for the test."

quests.conceptTitle: Speech Bubble to Report Converter: Mixed Reported Speech

quests.reportedSpeech: The agent asked whether I would be available the next day.

quests.backshiftSummary: 🔄 Quote ➔ Report: "The agent asked, "Will you be available tomorrow?"" ➔ "The agent asked whether I would be available the next day."

quests.conceptTitle: Speech Bubble to Report Converter: Mixed Reported Speech

quests.reportedSpeech: Diego asked whether I had seen that movie the previous week.

quests.nativeTip: Four separate items change: the tense, the demonstrative, and the time expression, plus the word order.
quests.backshiftSummary: 🔄 Quote ➔ Report: "Diego asked, "Did you see this movie last week?"" ➔ "Diego asked whether I had seen that movie the previous week."

quests.conceptTitle: Speech Bubble to Report Converter: Mixed Reported Speech
quests.directSpeech: The coordinator asked, "Can we meet here tomorrow?"
quests.reportedSpeech: The coordinator asked whether they could meet there the next day.
quests.ruleExplanation: 'We' becomes 'they', 'can' becomes 'could', 'here' becomes 'there', and 'tomorrow' becomes 'the next day'.
quests.nativeTip: Update the pronoun, the modal, the place word, and the time word all together.
quests.backshiftSummary: 🔄 Quote ➔ Report: "The coordinator asked, "Can we meet here tomorrow?"" ➔ "The coordinator asked whether they could meet there the next day."

quests.conceptTitle: Speech Bubble to Report Converter: Reported Yes/No Question
quests.directSpeech: Nadia asked herself, "Should I take the job?"
quests.reportedSpeech: Nadia wondered whether to take the job.
changesList: 'if' cannot precede an infinitive; 'whether' is used instead
quests.ruleExplanation: Only 'whether' allows the pattern 'whether + to-infinitive'; 'if' is not used this way, and the question inversion must be removed.
quests.nativeTip: 'Whether' can be directly followed by a 'to' infinitive, but 'if' cannot.
quests.backshiftSummary: 🔄 Quote ➔ Report: "Nadia asked herself, "Should I take the job?"" ➔ "Nadia wondered whether to take the job."

quests.conceptTitle: Speech Bubble to Report Converter: Reported Yes/No Question
quests.directSpeech: Marcus asked himself, "Should I call her back?"
quests.reportedSpeech: Marcus wondered whether to call her back.
quests.ruleExplanation: 'Whether + to-infinitive' replaces 'should I...'; 'if' cannot be followed directly by an infinitive.
quests.nativeTip: Drop 'should' entirely and replace it with a bare 'to' infinitive after 'whether'.
quests.backshiftSummary: 🔄 Quote ➔ Report: "Marcus asked himself, "Should I call her back?"" ➔ "Marcus wondered whether to call her back."

quests.conceptTitle: Speech Bubble to Report Converter: Reported Yes/No Question
quests.directSpeech: The team debated, "Should we launch the product now or wait?"
quests.reportedSpeech: The team debated whether to launch the product then or wait.
quests.ruleExplanation: 'Should we launch' becomes 'to launch', and 'now' becomes 'then', matching the required whether-infinitive pattern.
quests.nativeTip: Combine the infinitive pattern with the correct time-word change.
quests.backshiftSummary: 🔄 Quote ➔ Report: "The team debated, "Should we launch the product now or wait?"" ➔ "The team debated whether to launch the product then or wait."

quests.nativeTip: Recall how present perfect and question order both change together.
quests.backshiftSummary: 🔄 Quote ➔ Report: "The interviewer asked, "Have you ever managed a team?"" ➔ "The interviewer asked whether I had ever managed a team."

quests.conceptTitle: Speech Bubble to Report Converter: Reported Yes/No Question

quests.reportedSpeech: The waiter asked whether I would like to see the dessert menu.

quests.backshiftSummary: 🔄 Quote ➔ Report: "The waiter asked, "Would you like to see the dessert menu?"" ➔ "The waiter asked whether I would like to see the dessert menu."

quests.backshiftSummary: 🔄 Quote ➔ Report: "The recruiter asked, "Can you start next month?"" ➔ "The recruiter asked whether I could start the following month."
